rules.statement: Where the plaintiff denied possession of certain documents which the defendant alleged were relevant to his case, and new evidence was discovered after the hearing indicating that the documents were in fact in the possession of the plaintiff, the case should be re-opened so that the trial Judge might consider the new evidence and decide on its effect and, if necessary, vary his order.
rules.supporting_quote: Held , that, as the failure to produce the new evidence earlier was not due to the defendant�s negligence or default, the case should be re-opened so that the trial Judge might consider the new evidence and decide on its effect and, if necessary, vary his order.
